title: "Module 14: TCGA-GBM validation of PRKCD-associated biology"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 14 — BULK RNA-SEQ VALIDATION — TCGA
#==============================================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Validate a candidate gene identified from single-cell and spatial analyses
#   using TCGA bulk RNA-seq data obtained through UCSC Xena.
#
# Analyses:
#   1. Download TCGA RNA-seq and survival data
#   2. Retain primary tumor samples
#   3. Define target-gene high and low tumors
#   4. Differential expression analysis
#   5. Volcano plot and DEG heatmap
#   6. Hallmark GSEA
#   7. ESTIMATE tumor-microenvironment analysis
#   8. Target-gene high vs low ESTIMATE comparisons
#   9. Target-gene correlations with ESTIMATE scores
#  10. Overall survival analysis
#
# Main settings:
#   tcga_project <- "GBM"
#   target_gene  <- "PRKCD"
#
#==============================================================================


#==============================================================================
# 1. Libraries
#==============================================================================

library(UCSCXenaTools)
library(here)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

library(limma)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)

library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)

library(immunedeconv)

library(survival)
library(survminer)

set.seed(1234)


#==============================================================================
# 2. User settings
#==============================================================================

tcga_project <- "GBM"

target_gene <- "PRKCD"

dea_fdr_threshold <- 0.05
dea_logfc_threshold <- 1

gsea_fdr_threshold <- 0.05
gsea_min_size <- 15
gsea_max_size <- 500
gsea_top_pathways <- 10

volcano_label_genes <- 15
heatmap_top_genes <- 25

correlation_fdr_threshold <- 0.05


#==============================================================================
# 3. Analysis identifier
#==============================================================================

analysis_prefix <- paste(
  "TCGA",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene,
  sep = "_"
)


#==============================================================================
# 4. Project directories
#==============================================================================

tcga_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project
)

processed_data_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)

dea_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "DEA"
)

gsea_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "GSEA"
)

immune_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "immune_deconvolution"
)

correlation_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "correlations"
)

survival_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "survival"
)

figures_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)

dea_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "DEA"
)

gsea_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "GSEA"
)

immune_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "immune_deconvolution"
)

correlation_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "correlations"
)

survival_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "survival"
)

output_directories <- c(
  tcga_directory,
  processed_data_directory,
  results_directory,
  dea_results_directory,
  gsea_results_directory,
  immune_results_directory,
  correlation_results_directory,
  survival_results_directory,
  figures_directory,
  dea_figure_directory,
  gsea_figure_directory,
  immune_figure_directory,
  correlation_figure_directory,
  survival_figure_directory
)

for (directory in output_directories) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 5. Helper functions
#==============================================================================

save_ggplot <- function(
  plot_object,
  filename,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename, ".png"),
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


safe_spearman <- function(
  x,
  y
) {
  keep <- complete.cases(
    x,
    y
  )

  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]

  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
    length(unique(x)) < 2 ||
    length(unique(y)) < 2
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        n_samples = length(x),
        correlation = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      x,
      y,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  data.frame(
    n_samples = length(x),
    correlation = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}


prepare_deconvolution_long <- function(
  deconvolution_results,
  sample_metadata
) {
  deconvolution_results %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -cell_type,
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "score"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = as.numeric(score)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      sample_metadata %>%
        dplyr::select(
          sample,
          target_expression,
          target_group
        ),
      by = "sample"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(score),
      !is.na(target_expression),
      !is.na(target_group)
    )
}


#==============================================================================
# 6. Identify TCGA RNA-seq and clinical datasets
#==============================================================================

tcga_info <- UCSCXenaTools::getTCGAdata(
  project = tcga_project,
  clinical = TRUE,
  mRNASeq = TRUE,
  mRNASeqType = "normalized",
  download = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 7. Download TCGA RNA-seq and clinical data
#==============================================================================

tcga_download <- UCSCXenaTools::getTCGAdata(
  project = tcga_project,
  clinical = TRUE,
  mRNASeq = TRUE,
  mRNASeqType = "normalized",
  download = TRUE,
  destdir = tcga_directory
)


#==============================================================================
# 8. Prepare downloaded TCGA data
#==============================================================================

tcga_data <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaPrepare(
  tcga_download
)


#==============================================================================
# 9. Identify expression and clinical objects
#==============================================================================

rna_object_name <- grep(
  "^HiSeqV2(\\.gz)?$",
  names(tcga_data),
  value = TRUE
)

clinical_object_name <- grep(
  "clinicalMatrix",
  names(tcga_data),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(rna_object_name) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the HiSeqV2 expression dataset."
  )
}

if (length(clinical_object_name) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the clinical dataset."
  )
}

expression_data <- tcga_data[[rna_object_name]]

clinical_data <- tcga_data[[clinical_object_name]]


#==============================================================================
# 10. Download or locate survival data
#==============================================================================

survival_file <- file.path(
  tcga_directory,
  "survival",
  paste0(
    tcga_project,
    "_survival.txt"
  )
)

if (!file.exists(survival_file)) {
  xena_tcga <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaGenerate(
    subset = XenaHostNames == "tcgaHub"
  )

  survival_dataset_name <- paste0(
    "survival/",
    tcga_project,
    "_survival.txt"
  )

  survival_xena <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaFilter(
    xena_tcga,
    filterDatasets = survival_dataset_name
  )

  available_survival_datasets <- UCSCXenaTools::datasets(
    survival_xena
  )

  if (!survival_dataset_name %in% available_survival_datasets) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Could not locate survival dataset: ",
        survival_dataset_name
      )
    )
  }

  survival_query <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaQuery(
    survival_xena
  )

  survival_download <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaDownload(
    survival_query,
    destdir = tcga_directory
  )
}

if (!file.exists(survival_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Survival file was not found: ",
      survival_file
    )
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 11. Load survival data
#==============================================================================

survival_data_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  survival_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 12. Prepare expression matrix
#==============================================================================

expression_data <- as.data.frame(
  expression_data,
  check.names = FALSE
)

gene_column <- colnames(expression_data)[1]

gene_names <- as.character(
  expression_data[[gene_column]]
)

expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  expression_data[
    ,
    setdiff(
      colnames(expression_data),
      gene_column
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

storage.mode(expression_matrix) <- "numeric"

rownames(expression_matrix) <- gene_names

valid_gene_rows <- !is.na(rownames(expression_matrix)) &
  rownames(expression_matrix) != ""

expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
  valid_gene_rows,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(expression_matrix)) > 0) {
  expression_matrix <- limma::avereps(
    expression_matrix
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 13. Retain primary tumor samples
#==============================================================================

# TCGA sample-type code 01 = Primary Solid Tumor.

sample_barcodes <- colnames(
  expression_matrix
)

sample_type <- substr(
  sample_barcodes,
  14,
  15
)

primary_samples <- sample_barcodes[
  sample_type == "01"
]

if (length(primary_samples) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No TCGA primary tumor samples were found."
  )
}

expression_primary <- expression_matrix[
  ,
  primary_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

message(
  "Primary tumors retained: ",
  ncol(expression_primary)
)


#==============================================================================
# 14. Define target-gene expression groups
#==============================================================================

if (!target_gene %in% rownames(expression_primary)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Target gene ",
      target_gene,
      " was not found in the expression matrix."
    )
  )
}

target_expression <- as.numeric(
  expression_primary[
    target_gene,
    ,
    drop = TRUE
  ]
)

names(target_expression) <- colnames(
  expression_primary
)

target_cutpoint <- median(
  target_expression,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

target_group <- ifelse(
  target_expression > target_cutpoint,
  "High",
  "Low"
)

target_group <- factor(
  target_group,
  levels = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  )
)

sample_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expression_primary),
  patient = substr(
    colnames(expression_primary),
    1,
    12
  ),
  target_expression = target_expression,
  target_group = target_group,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message(
  target_gene,
  " median cutpoint: ",
  round(target_cutpoint, 4)
)

print(
  table(sample_metadata$target_group)
)


#==============================================================================
# 15. Save processed bulk data
#==============================================================================

write.csv(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_sample_metadata.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  expression_primary,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_primary_tumor_expression.rds"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  clinical_data,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_clinical_data.rds"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  survival_data_raw,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_survival_data_raw.rds"
    )
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 16. Differential expression analysis
#==============================================================================

design <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + target_group
)

colnames(design) <- c(
  "Low",
  "High"
)

fit <- limma::lmFit(
  expression_primary,
  design
)

contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
  High_vs_Low = High - Low,
  levels = design
)

fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(
  fit,
  contrast_matrix
)

fit <- limma::eBayes(
  fit
)

dea_results <- limma::topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "High_vs_Low",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "P"
)

dea_results <- dea_results %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    var = "gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < dea_fdr_threshold &
        logFC >= dea_logfc_threshold ~ "Up",
      adj.P.Val < dea_fdr_threshold &
        logFC <= -dea_logfc_threshold ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

write.csv(
  dea_results,
  file.path(
    dea_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_DEA.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 17. Volcano plot
#==============================================================================

volcano_data <- dea_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    minus_log10_fdr = -log10(
      pmax(
        adj.P.Val,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      )
    )
  )

volcano_labels <- volcano_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "NS"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    adj.P.Val
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = volcano_label_genes
  )

volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = minus_log10_fdr,
    color = significance
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -dea_logfc_threshold,
      dea_logfc_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(dea_fdr_threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = volcano_labels,
    aes(
      label = gene
    ),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "red",
      "Down" = "blue",
      "NS" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "TCGA-",
      tcga_project,
      " ",
      target_gene,
      " high vs low"
    ),
    x = "log2 fold change",
    y = "-log10 FDR",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  )

print(
  volcano_plot
)

save_ggplot(
  volcano_plot,
  file.path(
    dea_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_volcano"
    )
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)


#==============================================================================
# 18. Differential-expression heatmap
#==============================================================================

heatmap_genes <- dea_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "NS"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    adj.P.Val
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = heatmap_top_genes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    gene
  )

if (length(heatmap_genes) > 1) {
  heatmap_matrix <- expression_primary[
    heatmap_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  heatmap_matrix <- t(
    scale(
      t(heatmap_matrix)
    )
  )

  heatmap_annotation <- data.frame(
    target_group = sample_metadata$target_group
  )

  rownames(heatmap_annotation) <- sample_metadata$sample

  heatmap_colors <- list(
    target_group = c(
      "Low" = "blue",
      "High" = "red"
    )
  )

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    annotation_col = heatmap_annotation,
    annotation_colors = heatmap_colors,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    scale = "none",
    filename = file.path(
      dea_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        analysis_prefix,
        "_DEA_heatmap.png"
      )
    ),
    width = 9,
    height = 8
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 19. Prepare ranked genes for GSEA
#==============================================================================

# Limma moderated t-statistic used for pre-ranked GSEA.

gsea_ranks <- dea_results$t

names(gsea_ranks) <- dea_results$gene

gsea_ranks <- gsea_ranks[
  is.finite(gsea_ranks)
]

gsea_ranks <- sort(
  gsea_ranks,
  decreasing = TRUE
)


#==============================================================================
# 20. Hallmark GSEA
#==============================================================================

hallmark_gene_sets <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  collection = "H"
)

hallmark_pathways <- split(
  hallmark_gene_sets$gene_symbol,
  hallmark_gene_sets$gs_name
)

hallmark_pathways <- lapply(
  hallmark_pathways,
  unique
)

hallmark_gsea <- fgsea::fgsea(
  pathways = hallmark_pathways,
  stats = gsea_ranks,
  minSize = gsea_min_size,
  maxSize = gsea_max_size,
  eps = 0
)

hallmark_gsea <- as.data.frame(
  hallmark_gsea
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    padj
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = ifelse(
      NES > 0,
      "High",
      "Low"
    )
  )

hallmark_gsea_save <- hallmark_gsea

hallmark_gsea_save$leadingEdge <- vapply(
  hallmark_gsea_save$leadingEdge,
  paste,
  collapse = ";",
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

write.csv(
  hallmark_gsea_save,
  file.path(
    gsea_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_Hallmark_GSEA.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

hallmark_plot_data <- hallmark_gsea %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(padj),
    padj < gsea_fdr_threshold
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    padj,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = gsea_top_pathways
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway_label = gsub(
      "^HALLMARK_",
      "",
      pathway
    ),
    pathway_label = gsub(
      "_",
      " ",
      pathway_label
    ),
    minus_log10_fdr = -log10(
      pmax(
        padj,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      )
    )
  )

if (nrow(hallmark_plot_data) > 0) {
  hallmark_plot <- ggplot(
    hallmark_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = NES,
      y = reorder(
        pathway_label,
        NES
      ),
      size = minus_log10_fdr,
      color = direction
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "High" = "red",
        "Low" = "blue"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "TCGA-",
        tcga_project,
        " ",
        target_gene,
        " GSEA"
      ),
      subtitle = "Hallmark",
      x = "Normalized enrichment score",
      y = NULL,
      size = "-log10 FDR",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    )

  print(
    hallmark_plot
  )

  save_ggplot(
    hallmark_plot,
    file.path(
      gsea_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        analysis_prefix,
        "_Hallmark_GSEA_dotplot"
      )
    ),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 21. Prepare expression for ESTIMATE
#==============================================================================

immune_expression <- expression_primary

immune_expression <- immune_expression[
  rowSums(
    is.finite(immune_expression)
  ) == ncol(immune_expression),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


#==============================================================================
# 22. Run ESTIMATE with immunedeconv
#==============================================================================

estimate_results <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(
  gene_expression = immune_expression,
  method = "estimate"
)

estimate_results <- as.data.frame(
  estimate_results,
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(estimate_results)[1] <- "cell_type"

write.csv(
  estimate_results,
  file.path(
    immune_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_results.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 23. Prepare ESTIMATE results
#==============================================================================

estimate_long <- prepare_deconvolution_long(
  estimate_results,
  sample_metadata
)

write.csv(
  estimate_long,
  file.path(
    immune_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_scores_long.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 24. PRKCD high vs low ESTIMATE statistics
#==============================================================================

estimate_statistics <- estimate_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_low = sum(
      target_group == "Low"
    ),
    n_high = sum(
      target_group == "High"
    ),
    median_low = median(
      score[target_group == "Low"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_high = median(
      score[target_group == "High"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_difference = median_high - median_low,
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      score ~ target_group,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    p_adjusted
  )

write.csv(
  estimate_statistics,
  file.path(
    immune_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_statistics.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 25. ESTIMATE high vs low boxplots
#==============================================================================

estimate_boxplot <- ggplot(
  estimate_long,
  aes(
    x = target_group,
    y = score,
    fill = target_group
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.40
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ cell_type,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Low" = "blue",
      "High" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "TCGA-",
      tcga_project,
      " ESTIMATE"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      target_gene,
      "-high vs ",
      target_gene,
      "-low"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "ESTIMATE score",
    fill = target_gene
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(
  estimate_boxplot
)

save_ggplot(
  estimate_boxplot,
  file.path(
    immune_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_boxplots"
    )
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)


#==============================================================================
# 26. PRKCD correlations with ESTIMATE scores
#==============================================================================

estimate_correlations <- estimate_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ safe_spearman(
      .x$target_expression,
      .x$score
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    p_adjusted
  )

write.csv(
  estimate_correlations,
  file.path(
    correlation_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_purity_correlations.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 27. ESTIMATE correlation scatterplots
#==============================================================================

estimate_plot_data <- estimate_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    estimate_correlations %>%
      dplyr::select(
        cell_type,
        correlation,
        p_adjusted
      ),
    by = "cell_type"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_label = paste0(
      cell_type,
      "\nSpearman R = ",
      sprintf(
        "%.2f",
        correlation
      ),
      " | FDR = ",
      formatC(
        p_adjusted,
        format = "g",
        digits = 2
      )
    )
  )

estimate_correlation_plot <- ggplot(
  estimate_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = target_expression,
    y = score
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ plot_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "TCGA-",
      tcga_project,
      " ",
      target_gene,
      " and tumor microenvironment"
    ),
    subtitle = "Association with ESTIMATE-derived scores",
    x = paste0(
      target_gene,
      " expression"
    ),
    y = "ESTIMATE-derived score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  )

print(
  estimate_correlation_plot
)

save_ggplot(
  estimate_correlation_plot,
  file.path(
    correlation_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_ESTIMATE_purity_correlations"
    )
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)


#==============================================================================
# 28. Prepare survival data
#==============================================================================

sample_column_candidates <- c(
  "sample",
  "_PATIENT",
  "sampleID",
  "SampleID",
  "patient",
  "bcr_patient_barcode"
)

sample_column <- sample_column_candidates[
  sample_column_candidates %in% colnames(survival_data_raw)
][1]

if (
  length(sample_column) == 0 ||
  is.na(sample_column)
) {
  sample_column <- colnames(survival_data_raw)[1]
}

required_survival_columns <- c(
  "OS",
  "OS.time"
)

missing_survival_columns <- setdiff(
  required_survival_columns,
  colnames(survival_data_raw)
)

if (length(missing_survival_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing survival columns:",
      paste(
        missing_survival_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

survival_data <- survival_data_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    survival_sample = as.character(
      .data[[sample_column]]
    ),
    patient = substr(
      as.character(
        .data[[sample_column]]
      ),
      1,
      12
    ),
    OS = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(OS)
    ),
    OS_time = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(OS.time)
    )
  )

expression_patient_data <- sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    patient,
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    patient,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

survival_expression <- expression_patient_data %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    survival_data,
    by = "patient"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(OS),
    !is.na(OS_time),
    !is.na(target_expression),
    OS_time > 0
  )

survival_expression$target_group <- factor(
  survival_expression$target_group,
  levels = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  )
)

write.csv(
  survival_expression,
  file.path(
    survival_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_survival_data.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 29. Kaplan-Meier survival analysis
#==============================================================================

km_fit <- survival::survfit(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

logrank_test <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(
  logrank_test$chisq,
  df = length(logrank_test$n) - 1
)

km_plot <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
  fit = km_fit,
  data = survival_expression,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  pval = TRUE,
  pval.method = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  censor = TRUE,
  censor.shape = "|",
  censor.size = 3,
  palette = c(
    "blue",
    "red"
  ),
  legend.title = target_gene,
  legend.labs = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  ),
  xscale = 30.44,
  xlab = "Overall survival (months)",
  ylab = "Overall survival probability",
  title = paste0(
    "TCGA-",
    tcga_project,
    " overall survival"
  ),
  subtitle = paste0(
    target_gene,
    "-high vs ",
    target_gene,
    "-low primary tumors"
  ),
  ggtheme = theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  )
)

print(
  km_plot
)

png(
  filename = file.path(
    survival_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_overall_survival_KM.png"
    )
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 2600,
  res = 300
)

print(
  km_plot
)

dev.off()


#==============================================================================
# 30. Cox model — high vs low
#==============================================================================

cox_group <- survival::coxph(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

cox_group_summary <- summary(
  cox_group
)

group_term <- grep(
  "^target_group",
  rownames(cox_group_summary$coefficients),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

cox_group_results <- data.frame(
  model = "High vs Low",
  hazard_ratio = cox_group_summary$coefficients[
    group_term,
    "exp(coef)"
  ],
  lower_95_CI = cox_group_summary$conf.int[
    group_term,
    "lower .95"
  ],
  upper_95_CI = cox_group_summary$conf.int[
    group_term,
    "upper .95"
  ],
  p_value = cox_group_summary$coefficients[
    group_term,
    "Pr(>|z|)"
  ]
)


#==============================================================================
# 31. Cox model — continuous expression
#==============================================================================

survival_expression <- survival_expression %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_expression_z = as.numeric(
      scale(target_expression)
    )
  )

cox_continuous <- survival::coxph(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_expression_z,
  data = survival_expression
)

cox_continuous_summary <- summary(
  cox_continuous
)

cox_continuous_results <- data.frame(
  model = "Expression per 1 SD",
  hazard_ratio = cox_continuous_summary$coefficients[
    "target_expression_z",
    "exp(coef)"
  ],
  lower_95_CI = cox_continuous_summary$conf.int[
    "target_expression_z",
    "lower .95"
  ],
  upper_95_CI = cox_continuous_summary$conf.int[
    "target_expression_z",
    "upper .95"
  ],
  p_value = cox_continuous_summary$coefficients[
    "target_expression_z",
    "Pr(>|z|)"
  ]
)

cox_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cox_group_results,
  cox_continuous_results
)

write.csv(
  cox_results,
  file.path(
    survival_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_Cox_results.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 32. Proportional hazards checks
#==============================================================================

cox_group_ph <- survival::cox.zph(
  cox_group
)

cox_continuous_ph <- survival::cox.zph(
  cox_continuous
)

print(
  cox_group_ph
)

print(
  cox_continuous_ph
)


#==============================================================================
# 33. Save validation results
#==============================================================================

bulk_validation_results <- list(
  settings = list(
    tcga_project = tcga_project,
    target_gene = target_gene,
    target_cutpoint = target_cutpoint,
    dea_fdr_threshold = dea_fdr_threshold,
    dea_logfc_threshold = dea_logfc_threshold,
    gsea_fdr_threshold = gsea_fdr_threshold
  ),
  clinical_data = clinical_data,
  sample_metadata = sample_metadata,
  expression_primary = expression_primary,
  dea_results = dea_results,
  hallmark_gsea = hallmark_gsea,
  estimate = list(
    results = estimate_results,
    statistics = estimate_statistics,
    correlations = estimate_correlations
  ),
  survival = list(
    data = survival_expression,
    km_fit = km_fit,
    logrank_p = logrank_p,
    cox_group = cox_group,
    cox_continuous = cox_continuous,
    cox_results = cox_results
  )
)

saveRDS(
  bulk_validation_results,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_bulk_validation_results.rds"
    )
  )
)


message(
  "TCGA-",
  tcga_project,
  " ",
  target_gene,
  " validation complete."
)
```
